verdict.line: You lose if you eat a full Counter Strike (E) stun while over-extending for Fury; you win if you force fights the moment your Fury crosses 50 and his Counter Strike is down.

brief.thesis: This is a stun-versus-dodge duel: your Ruthless Predator (W) escalates from a 0.75s double-slash to a 1.5s triple-slash that strips shields once you're above 50 Fury, but Jax's Counter Strike (E) dodges the basic attacks you need to build that Fury and punishes a committed engage with its own stun. The 51.4% Renekton win rate over 718 games and Renekton's stated lane advantage hold as long as you time your all-ins around his Counter Strike cooldown instead of his health bar.

theirWindow.when: Counter Strike (E) is up and ready
theirWindow.what: He wants you to auto or empowered-W him into an active Counter Strike so it dodges the hit and stuns you back. Poke with Q or wait for E to go on cooldown (18/16/14/12/10s) before committing autos.

yourWindow.when: Fury over 50 and his E on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Land Q first for the Fury threshold, then chain the empowered triple-slash W (1.5s stun, strips shields) into E (Slice and Dice) for the armor-shred bonus damage. This is your full commit window.

start.why: Picked in 69.5% of games at a 53.1% win rate; the extra AD and sustain let you win the early autoattack trades that build Fury toward your empowered W.

boots.why: 76.3% pick rate at 52.3% win rate; flat damage reduction against Jax's auto-attack-based Empower (W) and his ramping Relentless Assault (R) hits harder over the game than magic resist does.

core.why: Proc'd by your Q/W/E combo for burst and a shield exactly when Jax tries to punish your all-in with Counter Strike's counter-stun.
Ability haste shortens W (down to 8s) and E (down to 10s) at max rank, letting you re-threaten Counter Strike windows more often; the armor shred stacks with E's own shred.
Highest-winrate third item at 62% over 108 games; the damage-over-time conversion keeps you alive through Jax's Relentless Assault attack-speed spikes.

situational.when: he outscales you and starts winning extended attack-speed trades
you want faster W/E cooldowns to punish every Counter Strike window
you need to catch his Leap Strike (Q) mobility to close a fight

runes.keystoneWhy: Highest pick rate (46.9%) and win rate (49.3%) for this matchup; the sustained adaptive damage and healing stacks through repeated Q/W/E trades better than a one-shot keystone in a duel where fights run long.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is run in 83.1% of games at a 52.5% win rate and matches your job here: force the all-in the moment his Counter Strike is down and secure the kill before he can reset with Relentless Assault. Flash+Teleport (14.8% pick) is the alternative if you're prioritizing scaling and side-lane pressure over lane kills.

playing.title: Auto him before you commit
playing.detail: Reign of Anger only generates Fury from attacks, so land a couple of autos or a Q first to cross 50 Fury before you commit to the empowered W stun.

playing.title: Never W into active Counter Strike
playing.detail: OP.GG's own read on this matchup: don't fire your reinforced W while his Counter Strike (E) is up, since it dodges the hit and he stuns you back on the follow-up.

playing.title: Punish right after his E whiffs
playing.detail: Counter Strike's cooldown runs 18/16/14/12/10s by rank; once it's down and confirmed empty, that's your green light to dump the full Q-W-E combo.

playing.title: Trade after his Empower (W) is spent
playing.detail: His Empower (W) recharges in as little as 3-7s, but the moment after he uses it for a leap or auto, his burst window is closed until it's back up.

playing.title: Use Dominus to extend fights, not start them
playing.detail: Pop Dominus (R) mid-fight rather than on engage; the periodic Fury it grants keeps your W and Q empowered for the whole duration instead of just the opener.

playing.title: Cut fights short past level 9
playing.detail: His zero-cooldown Relentless Assault (R) ramps attack speed and adds bonus damage every third hit, so drawn-out trades increasingly favor him as the game goes on — win it fast with your burst or don't start it.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoners, and win rates above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.18.1); the timing reads, cooldown interactions, and trade patterns are my own tactical analysis layered on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful not to use Renekton’s reinforced [W] while Jax has Counter Strike (E) active. Keep an eye out on Jax’s Conqueror and (P) stacks before engaging combat.
